description:
[Trading Data API] Top-of-book depth + spread (bps) from Binance, Bybit, or Hyperliquid.

**Example:** `/v1/orderbook?symbol=BTC&exchange=binance&depth=10`

Use when you need top-of-book depth and spread (bps) on Binance, Bybit or Hyperliquid. Not for a prediction-market book (use kalshi_market).

Behavior: read-only. Priced via x402 (USDC on Base) or free with WICKEDAPI_API_KEY; with neither, you get HTTP 402 with the decoded price in payment_required (a price quote, not a failure).
name: orderbook
